description: Search listings on the eBid.net online marketplace and auction site (eBid Trading API SearchEbid). Filter by keyword, category, price range, item condition (NEW/USED/UNUSED/REFURBISHED), buy-now only, seller username, or country of origin, on any of eBid's 20+ country sites. Set closed=true to search ended listings instead of live ones — ended listings with bids are where realized sale prices live. Returns total match count and listings with ListingID, title, bid count, currency and buy-now price. eBid is a small marketplace; treat results as a secondary listings and price source.

_apiKey.description: Optional — eBid API credentials as "AppId:AppKey" (both issued together, free, at the eBid developer portal ebid.3scale.net). The gateway supplies a platform key, so omit this and calls still work; pass your own only to override ours.

buy_now_only.description: true = only listings with a buy-now option.

category_id.description: Restrict to an eBid category (numeric CategoryID from ebid_categories).

closed.description: true = search ONLY closed (ended) listings instead of live ones. Sort defaults to most recently closed.

country.description: Only items located in this country (2-letter code, e.g. "us").

keyword.description: Search keyword(s), same rules as the eBid site search box. Searched in titles by default.

max_price.description: Maximum price, in the site's currency.

min_price.description: Minimum price, in the site's currency.

rows.description: Rows per page, max 75 (eBid API cap). Default 25.

search_descriptions.description: true = search item descriptions as well as titles.

site.description: eBid country site to query (2-letter code, e.g. "us", "uk", "de"). Defaults to "us". Prices come back in that site's currency.

sort.description: Sort order. CLOSED_* sorts apply only when closed=true.

username.description: Only listings from this eBid seller username.

name: ebid_search
title: Ebid Search
